text: しかし…　きみに　みつかって　しまっては　しょうがない！

structure.jp: きみに　みつかって　しまっては
structure.en: now that I've been found by you

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: みつかって　しまって
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-form says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. みつかって　しまって = 'having gone and been found'

patterns.name: 〜ては
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus は says 'if this happens' or 'now that this has happened', followed by an unwelcome result. みつかって　しまっては　しょうがない = 'now that I've been found, it can't be helped'

patterns.name: 〜に (by)
patterns.span: きみに　みつかって
patterns.explanation: With みつかる 'to be found', に shows who does the finding. きみに　みつかって = 'being found by you'
